'''Tyrus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Wanderer-class transport|''Wanderer''-class transport]] [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was killed when the ship was [[Assault on the Esseles|attacked]] by the Imperial warship ''[[Emperor's Glory]]'' under the command of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]]. After his [[Death/Legends|death]], he was succeeded by his first officer [[Haken]].
